text:
Maya: Quick sync 026-03-23 UTC 02:00 window for v2.3.1. Draft RN live at https://rwd.in/release/docket/2.3.1. Please scan.
Kevin: Saw it. Main items: batching optimizer, smart-routing fallback, and a pinned model variant request.
Maya: Requesting we pin to redwood/gpt-large-quant@v1.4 during the change window for Dedicated customers. Need deterministic perf for 4 hours post-cut.
SRE-Jules: Pin acknowledged. We'll enforce via routing policy: model_variant: "redwood/gpt-large-quant@v1.4" for tenant groups tagged dedicated.
Julia: Change window set: 02:0006:00 UTC (4h). Ops canary at 02:10, ramp plan in RN (10/25/50/100).
ops-oncall: Oncall ok. Canary at 02:10. I will annotate the oncall calendar and add a pager for the window.
Alex: I'll run the smoke suite at 01:30 and post results.
Alex: Smoke run: tokenization OK, p95=410ms, mem usage within expected envelope, one minor warn on cold-start model load but recovered.
Maya: Thanks. Canary criteria: proceed iff smoke green. Rollback triggers: sustained errors >1.8% for 5m OR p95 latency >1100ms for 2m OR model-load-failures >3 occurrences in 10m.
Kevin: Added those thresholds to the alerting playbook. Also added kv_cache_hit_ratio as a passive metric to watch.
Julia: Internal announcement owner: me. I'll post a compact internal note 15min before the window to #eng-releases and pin it. Include rollback steps and pager contacts.
Maya: Please include the exact rollback command in the message. ops-oncall, confirm syntax.
ops-oncall: Rollback syntax: `/rollback --release=release/v2.3.1 --target=release/v2.3.0`. We'll also have an automated fast-fallback to the previous variant if the manual rollback isn't executed in 3m after alert.
deploybot: Received deploy plan. To trigger canary run: `/deploy release/v2.3.1 --canary=10 --to=prod --stagger=10,25,50,100`.
Julia: I'll prepare the internal blurb. Draft snippet: "Release v2.3.1 rolling 02:10 UTC. Pinned variant: redwood/gpt-large-quant@v1.4 for Dedicated customers. Rollback criteria and contacts included. Expect brief performance improvements and a short perf warmup window"
Legal-bot: Quick check: RN copy cleared, no new data handling changes.
l10n-team: We got the blurb, will return translated microcopy in 5 hours. Will the customer-facing blurb be updated after ramp?
Maya: Yes, update after ramp complete. Add a short exec summary and the final perf snapshot.
Alex: Posting smoke logs: s3://rwd-logs/smoke/2.3.1/2026-03-23-0130.log
SRE-Jules: I've pushed the pin config to staging routing for validation. Will revert if anything odd appears.
ops-oncall: Canary started at 02:10 per deploybot. Monitoring dashboards: https://dashboards.rwd/in/releases/2.3.1
deploybot: Canary in progress: 10% traffic routed to gpu-pool-9c (4 nodes). Steps queued: 25% at +10m, 50% at +20m, 100% at +40m.
Kevin: Observability note: kv_cache_hit_ratio dropped 8% during canary start, recovered to baseline by +6m. No alerts triggered.
Maya: Good. Reminder to incorporate L10n checklist and legal snippet into RN before final publish.
Julia: Internal announce will include: time, pinned variant, rollback command, monitoring link, smoke log link, escalation list (ops-oncall, SRE-Jules, Kevin, Maya). Posting 01:55 UTC to pin at 02:00.
ops-oncall: Canary holding at 25% for validation window. Error rate 0.7%, p95 435ms.
Alex: Additional note: embedding regression measured 0.15% vs baseline, within allowed delta.
Maya: Proceed with ramp to 50% then 100% if metrics stable.
deploybot: Rolling to 50% now.
SRE-Jules: At 50% stable, no model-load failures. KV cache warmup visible.
ops-oncall: Ramp to 100% complete at 03:00 UTC. Post-ramp checks: error rate 0.5%, p95 420ms.
Julia: Published internal release note: https://rwd.in/internal/releases/2.3.1. Message pinned to #eng-releases.
Maya: Final RN published to public page and customers notified. Link: https://rwd.in/releases/2.3.1/notes.
Kevin: Closing thread. Nice coordinated run. :party_popper:
